decisions.reason: The terminal-comparison format and preservation constraint are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the new restrained terminal and the requirement to preserve the Hero V's established structure and slope.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the shared restrained terminal and preservation of the second V's established structure and slope.
The E and L remain unchanged; their exclusion of expressive flourish is already reconciled with the newly restrained V-and-accent terminal by the existing same-message MODIFY.
The source explicitly preserves the second V's established geometry and does not change its height relationship to the other letters.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already applies the restrained Hero V terminal style to the É accent while its literal derivation remains valid.
The terminal treatment changes consistently across the related forms, but the established Hero-V-to-accent peak alignment remains unchanged.
The source preserves the selected Balanced Flow composition, and that selection is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Changing the shared terminal treatment does not alter the obligation to explain the design rationale for each review round.
The terminal geometry is being reconsidered, but champagne gold remains assigned to the same Hero V right arm, second V right arm, and É accent elements.
The source delays proceeding with material treatments but does not replace, remove, or otherwise change the selected Satin Reflection finish.
Refining only the terminal while preserving the established V structures does not change the shared-baseline requirement.
